  • Experience with analytics platforms: Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Amazon Brand Analytics.
  • Understanding US market trends and consumer behaviour in digital commerce. Combined with creative thinking and the ability to draw inspiration from immediate (direct) and indirect competition/categories.

  • Familiarity with digital shelf analytics and share-of-voice tools (e.g., Profitero, Clavis, Edge by Ascential). Commerce IQ knowledge is a plus.
  • Exposure to content syndication systems (like Salsify, Syndigo).
  • Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS and technical SEO auditing.
  • Familiarity with tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Mongools is also preferred.
  • Understanding of broader eCommerce marketing (PPC, retail media, content strategy).

title: Sr Enginner, QA
description:
Who are we?

We are the Latin American branch of Match Group, the world's largest company for dating websites and apps. You've probably heard of some of our brands: Match.com , Tinder, OkCupid, Par Perfeito, Divino Amor, Our Time, Hinge, Stir, and many more!

Our mission is simple: to create meaningful connections for every person everywhere. Passion drives us, and we believe in love. We are relentless in our pursuit to build and integrate technology that will help connect people.

Currently, the group's brands worldwide include:

Par Perfeito - a pioneering brand in Brazil and the largest in online serious relationships.

Hinge - Hinge is an inclusive dating app for real people looking to meet others and pursue real-life relationships.

POF - a dating website for people seeking casual or serious relationships.

Match.com - the world's largest dating site.

Tinder - the leading global app to meet new people.


What We’re Looking For:
  • 2+ years of QA experience, with a focus on manual testing for mobile apps in an agile environment.
  • Strong understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies, ensuring you can assess and verify product quality at each stage.
  • Experience with test case management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail...), and the ability to manage, organize, and prioritize issues effectively.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical and problem-solving skills, enabling you to thoroughly investigate and resolve defects.
  • Clear, productive, and empathetic communication skills, both written and verbal, allowing you to articulate issues and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Commitment to producing high-quality work, with a focus on maintaining the integrity and performance in our apps.
  • Experience testing both web and mobile applications, offering flexibility and broader insights into testing environments.
  • Bonus: Experience with Litmus Email Testing and Test Automation tools/frameworks.
Responsibilities:
  • Design and implement testing workflows for the brand specific apps and websites.
  • Help document, organize, track, and prioritize known issues.
  • Help develop quantitative standards for assessing and maintaining app qualityHelp with triaging/investigating reported defects.
  • Facilitate cross-functional communication as it relates to ensuring the quality of our apps.
  • Execute manual QA testing geared towards regression and on-going projects in development.
Requirements:
  • Moderate knowledge of SQL and markup language testing (HTML/CSS, Razor)2 or 3+ years of experience.
  • Experience with testing Push and Email notifications.
  • Experience with testing C#/.Net servicesGit knowledge.
  • Experience with coordinating deployments with development teams and across an organization.
  • Understanding of Agile development and testing process.
  • Ability to understand and create test plans from specifications or verbal communications.
  • Experience with QA tools including bug/defect tracking systems; test management software such as JIRA, Excel, TFS, etc.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Bonus: Experience with Litmus Email Testing.
Please send your CV in English!

Why work with us?

Our mission is simple - to help people find love and happiness! We also take great care of our employees.

Here at Match Group LatAm, you'll have:

-Autonomy to develop in a light, fun, and technological environment that encourages innovation through technology;

-Flexibility for work and hours;

-Competitive salary package and bonuses, according to company policy;

-Competitive meal voucher/meal allowance;

-Health and dental plan, extendable to spouse and dependents for employees (not included for interns);

-Gympass to take care of your health even more;

-Home Office Assistance: every month you will receive an allowance to contribute to home office expenses;

-Incentive to participate in events;

-Udemy for Business: You'll have access to the Udemy platform, which offers over 183,000 online courses in various areas, on-demand;

-In-Company English: We have an in-company English teacher to help develop your second language. The company covers 80% of the costs and the employee covers 20%;

-Annual Check-up: To take care of our team's well-being, we offer an annual medical check-up for all employees aged 40+, promoting health and well-being through preventive medicine;

-"Baby Bonding Leave" - extended paternity leave. Here at #Match, we believe that caring for the next generation is a gender-neutral investment. As soon as an employee's baby is born, the father takes 100% paid leave for 12 weeks.

-International Career Opportunities: We have several cases of employees who have been expatriated to contribute to Match Group in other countries. Here, you have the autonomy and freedom of a local company, with the structure and resources of a global corporation.

We hope you feel excited to join our team, with the autonomy to bring your ideas to life without worrying about bureaucracy and rigid hierarchies.

How about helping people find love and happiness with us?

Multi Site Leader, BR Operations - Amazon Logistics

At Amazon, we treat every single day like it is Day One, and we never sit still while doing it. Are you ready to craft solutions and solve tomorrow’s problems today? Then we have the opportunity for you.
We are seeking a Multi Site Leader to join our First Mile team in Rio de Janeiro, RJ. In this role, you will provide inspiring and supportive leadership across multiple operational sites. At the same time, you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get involved when needed.
You will be directly responsible for developing a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports, while reporting to the Senior Operations Manager. The quality of your leadership will be key to your success. You will tactfully motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with those of the business.
Another key aspect of the role is leading process improvement projects aimed at streamlining operations for both yourself and the teams you support. The ideas, innovations, and bold steps you take to challenge the status quo may be adopted across the Amazon network. This is a unique opportunity, and it is yours for the taking.
Key job responsibilities
Your role will be pivotal in the overall management, control, organization, and direction of the SCP (Seller Processing Center). Your responsibilities will include, among others:
- Maintaining Health and Safety standards within your area of responsibility, while promoting and fostering a strong safety culture on site
- Becoming proficient in specific, large-scale processes and activities within SCPs, such as 5S audits
- Managing meaningful data collection within the inventory control and systems environment, and updating operational metrics on an hourly basis
- Striving to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors, and ensure an o utstanding customer and seller experience
- Collaborating closely with other support teams—such as HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, and IT—on staffing plans, schedules, and performance levels
- Driving progressive process improvements and contributing to cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your sites and across the broader Amazon Transportation network in Brazil

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Employee and performance management experience
- Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams
- Expertise in two or more production or supply chain areas, with an impressive track record in a similar, dynamic logistics, distribution or manufacturing environment
- Ability to organize details, establish and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyze the data you generate
- Advanced level in Excel (vlookup, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros); Fluent Portuguese and advanced English; Available to travel 20% of the time to visit SCPs in your regional

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Completed master’s degree or MBA;
- Experience with Kaizen and Lean methodologies and related techniques;
- Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations.

This transformation aims to offer enhanced project execution and knowledge-driven operational models by bridging the upstream culture of three continents across Asia, Europe, and America.
Summary
The Project Controls Manager (PCM) plays a crucial role in overseeing and implementing project controls activities, including cost management, planning and scheduling, progress monitoring, risk evaluation, change management, and reporting. These activities are conducted in accordance with both contractual obligations and internal standards throughout all stages of the project. The PCM is tasked with providing regular updates on project status, emphasizing key performance indicators, and delivering estimates and forecasts for the remaining project duration. Additionally, the PCM identifies potential risks and opportunities, supplying the Project Team with vital information to ensure effective project management and recommending corrective actions when necessary.
Accountabilities

  • Coordinate and support the development of Project Controls policies, procedures, systems & tools.
  • Ensure OBU Project Controls standards, policies, and procedures are adhered to on all OBU projects.
  • Accountable for the management of all planning and scheduling efforts for all projects including bid proposals, Pre-FEED/FEED, and EPC.
  • Accountable for the management of all cost control efforts including change management for all projects including bid proposals, Pre-FEED/FEED, and EPC.
  • Coordinate and support the development of business units / department budgets and develop consistent budget templates for presentation to OBU senior management.
  • Work with Estimating and Commercial team to interpret cost estimates into pricing for proposals.
  • Accountable for the development of project contingencies, work closely with Risk Manager in interpreting risks identified for the development of contingencies.
  • Support the Contracts Managers in adherence to contract T&Cs relating to cost and schedule issues at each project location.
  • Coordinate with corporate Finance and Accounting ensuring project costs are appropriately accounted for.
  • Work with Procurement/Supply Chain in development of RFQs, evaluation of quotations relating to cost and schedule.
  • Accountable for all progress reporting, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly for projects.
  • Work closely with yard Project Controls Managers in their efforts to manage projects (reporting, resources, training, etc.)
  • Continuously improve Projects Controls policies, procedures, systems, and tools.
  • Prepare and report KPIs for tendering and projects.
  • Manage the project progress reporting dashboard ensuring data are accurate and timely.
  • Establish the Project Controls Plan in accordance with the contract & Project Execution Plan (PEP) and communicate it with the relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure efficient resource management by optimizing allocation and clearly defining each individual’s role and responsibility within the actual project.
  • Ensure that all Project Controls functions are properly set up, the budget is seamlessly transferred from the WIN phase to project phase, WBS structures are established with booking/task codes in line with the contract and PEP, and project planning, progress measurement systems, as well as internal and external reporting including KPIs, are effectively implemented.
  • Ensure progress on the 90-day start-up plan during the initial project setup phase to establish the Control Baseline
  • Establish a project baseline schedule aligned with contract milestones and deliverables, ensuring it gains stakeholders’ approval.
Qualifications And Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in oil and gas industry within the Project Controls function.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, preferably as a Project Controls Manager.
  • Experience of major offshore project execution
  • Experience in the FPSO/FSO/FLNG sector highly desired.
  • Experience in Project Controls of EPCI projects including work at the yard.
  • Technical education at Bachelor level, Masters preferred.
  • Proficient in common computer applications with proficient MS Excel skills and Primavera P6 software.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written English in report writing, presentations, diplomacy and assertiveness is demanded.
  • Ability to independently prioritize tasks.
  • Ability to be pro-active and able to work and communicate with all team members and clients in achievement of the above responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of industry standard Project Controls best practices, AACE standards.

Your role is to oversee our video production ecosystem, ensuring flawless execution of 45-80 high-quality videos monthly (with a team of 3-5 people) while maintaining exceptional client satisfaction and channel growth.

Are you obsessed with YouTube (or Social Media)success? Someone who lives and breathes video optimization? Do you have a talent for managing multiple brand voices and coordinating creative teams? Are you equally comfortable diving into analytics and providing strategic direction? If so, we might be the perfect match.

Core Responsibilities

  • Coordinate resources across editing, thumbnail, and publishing teams
  • Manage channel optimization and publishing schedules for multiple real estate clients
  • Track and optimize team capacity and production efficiency
  • Implement and refine production SOPs and best practices

  • Ensure consistent 48-72 hour turnaround times while maintaining quality standards
  • Drive client success metrics including subscriber growth and lead generation

A Impact Media is a specialized creative agency helping real estate professionals build their own media brands instead of buying leads. We transform top-producing agents and teams (doing $10M to $1B+/YR in annual volume) into local market authorities through done-for-you YouTube content, email marketing, and brand development.

We're not just a service provider we're a growth partner obsessed with turning real estate professionals into media companies that naturally attract the right clients and team members.

Our core values of proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence drive everything we do.

About Varsity Tutors & Nerdy
Varsity Tutors, a Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) company, is a leading platform for live online learning with a mission to transform how people learn through technology. Our purpose-built proprietary platform, leveraging AI, seamlessly connects learners of all ages to experts across over 3,000 subjects and multiple formats, including one-on-one instruction, small group classes, and on-demand study support. As one of the nation's largest platforms for live online tutoring and classes, Varsity Tutors provides solutions directly to students, consumers, schools, and other institutions. Learn more about Nerdy at Overview
The Operations Support Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring a seamless learning experience by providing comprehensive support to our contracted tutors and students. This fast-paced, mission-driven environment requires a self-starter and problem-solver with a passion for helping people learn. This position is ideal for individuals who are adaptable and thrive in a dynamic contact center setting.
Key Responsibilities
As an Operations Support Specialist, you will:

  • Provide Comprehensive Tutor Support:
    • Handle inbound inquiries via phone, chat, email, and video within our learning platform.
    • Assist tutors with account setup, specific student opportunities/assignments, tutoring product inquiries, scheduling conflicts, and payment/payroll questions.
    • Complete various tutor support tasks, including account updates, reviews, document reviews, and subject assessments.
  • Resolve Technical Issues:
    • Provide real-time technical assistance to both instructors and students via chat and video.
    • Follow up on technical issues submitted via email, phone, chat, or video.
    • Escalate unresolved technical issues to the engineering team as per established processes.
  • Support and Audit Tutoring Sessions:
    • Monitor live online classes to ensure quality and adherence to guidelines.
    • Assist instructors with starting and ending class sessions.
  • Provide Insights for School System Partners:
    • Address and resolve complaints, offering appropriate solutions and alternatives.
    • Evaluate quality inputs such as compliance with client-defined requirements, tutor preparedness, and platform ease of use.
    • Intervene to address defects, including replacing tutors when necessary and escalating issues that impede student learning.
Qualifications
We are looking for individuals who possess:
  • B2 English proficiency.
  • Prior experience in a customer service contact center, handling inbound calls, chats, emails, or workloads.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (formerly Google documents).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • A solutions-based mindset, consistently seeking effective resolutions for end users.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work independently as a self-starter.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a dynamic environment with quickly changing priorities.
  • Willingness and ability to quickly learn business practices, policies, and procedures.
  • A commitment to going above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to demonstrate empathy and understanding when interacting with end users.
  • Comfortable performing all job responsibilities on a laptop or computer.
  • Able to perform basic technical troubleshooting with work equipment.
  • Reliable high-speed internet access (25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload) via wired ethernet connection (no Wi-Fi, Satellite, or Cellular Hotspot/Internet).
  • A quiet work environment that promotes focus.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Professional experience in recruiting, education, customer service, retail, or another fast-paced environment.
  • An Associate's degree or higher.
  • Experience with technical support.
  • Experience with Zendesk.
Work Schedule

title: ANALISTA FISCAL III
description:
Desenvolver atividades relacionadas ao Setor Fiscal, mantendo as operações fiscais de acordo com as legislações
Federais, Estaduais e Municipais para evitar autos de infração que possam comprometer os resultados da organização.
Conciliar as contas contábeis de tributos e analisar suas variações. Será responsável pelo processo de apuração e
análise de tributos Diretos e Indiretos, retenções na fonte e elaboração e envio das Obrigações Acessórias. Irá atuar na
viabilização de melhorias de processos, na elaboração de procedimentos fiscais, participação em projetos, apoio aos
clientes internos e externos, suporte as fiscalizações e auditorias interna e externa, bem como acompanhar as alterações
legislativas e de jurisprudência, garantindo sua aplicação no momento oportuno.

  • Realizar atividades qualificadas do setor Fiscal, efetuando cálculos, controles, conferências e análises, com a finalidade de agilizar os processos de sua área de atuação;
  • Apurar IRPJ, CSLL (Corrente e Diferido), PIS e COFINS no Lucro Real e tributos retidos;
  • Auxiliar nos cálculos de Transfer Pricing e benefícios fiscais, como Lei do Bem, PAT e etc;
  • Monitorar a apuração dos tributos incidentes nas operações comerciais realizadas pela empresa (IPI, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS e tributos retidos), analisando os livros contábeis e fiscais, para que sejam calculados e recolhidos conforme a legislação;
  • Analisar os documentos fiscais de entradas e saídas, verificando se estão preenchidos corretamente, constando as informações exigidas pelo fisco, para evitar que os fatos contábeis sejam escriturados de forma incorreta;
  • Efetuar o recebimento de documentos fiscais nos sistemas próprios, após análises;
  • Preparar e entregar as Obrigações Acessórias (ECF, ECD, EFD Contribuições, DCTFWEB, PER/DCOMP e etc);
  • Preparar relatórios fiscais e papéis de trabalho para o Corporate, Auditoria e Fiscalização;
  • Preparar conciliação das contas contábeis e analisar e explicar as variações mensais, trimestrais e anuais dos tributos apurados, através da aplicação das políticas contábeis internas;
  • Gerar as guias de recolhimento dos tributos, através dos sistemas disponibilizados pelos órgãos competentes, para atender as exigências da legislação fiscal, obedecendo a agenda tributária;
  • Atender à fiscalização Municipal, Estadual e Federal, apresentado os documentos necessários, a fim de evitar autos de infração para a empresa;
  • Atender auditoria interna e externa, de acordo com as políticas internas da empresa;
  • Orientação técnica aos Colaboradores de menor experiência, nas atividades realizadas, transmitindo instruções e acompanhando a execução das tarefas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de transformação e melhoria em procedimentos internos do Setor Fiscal;
  • Acompanhamento diário das alterações nas legislações fiscais;
  • Desenvolver/realizar outras atividades inerentes à sua área de atuação.

description:
Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Analista de Negócios Sênior (com foco em suprimentos)?
Sua missão será atuar como ponto focal entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de tecnologia e desenvolvimento. O objetivo principal é identificar, analisar e traduzir as necessidades e requisitos dessas áreas em soluções digitais eficazes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da organização. Você desempenhará um papel crucial na concepção, implementação e otimização de plataformas digitais internas e externas, garantindo a usabilidade, a conformidade regulatória e a integração com as práticas de sustentabilidade da empresa.
Essa é uma oportunidade no modelo 100% presencial no Rio de Janeiro.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Como Analista de Negócios Sênior (com foco em suprimentos), você focará em:

  • Análise de Requisitos: Conduzir workshops e entrevistas com stakeholders das áreas para coletar, documentar e analisar detalhadamente os requisitos de negócio, funcionais e não funcionais para projetos digitais.
  • Conhecimento Especializado: Aplicar conhecimento específico sobre as particularidades e necessidades das áreas de Suprimentos (Processos req-to-pay) e Gestão de Contratos (Gestão de fornecedores).
  • Interface e Comunicação: Atuar como um elo de comunicação eficaz entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes técnicas, garantindo o entendimento mútuo dos requisitos e das soluções propostas.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Monitorar e analisar o desempenho das plataformas, identificando oportunidades de otimização, melhoria da experiência do usuário e incorporação de novas funcionalidades.
  • Documentação: Elaborar e manter atualizada a documentação de requisitos, especificações funcionais, manuais de usuário e outros documentos relevantes para os projetos digitais.
  • Conformidade e Segurança: Garantir que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as políticas internas de segurança da informação e com as regulamentações externas aplicáveis.
  • Tendências e Inovação: Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e as melhores práticas em serviços digitais, propondo a adoção de novas soluções e abordagens que agreguem valor ao negócio.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Como requisitos básicos, buscamos:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada como Analista de Negócios, preferencialmente com foco em projetos digitais.
  • Habilidade em análise de requisitos, modelagem de processos e elaboração de especificações funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Experiência com metodologias de desenvolvimento de software (Agile, Waterfall, etc.).
  • Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, incluindo a capacidade de apresentar informações complexas de forma clara e concisa.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, colaborar com diferentes áreas e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de escritório (Pacote Office).Conhecimento SAP ERP S4/Hana módulo MM e Ariba.
  • Conhecimento softwares e-procurement Coupa e/ou GEP.


Você se destaca se tiver:

  • Certificações relevantes em análise de negócios ou gestão de projetos.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados e métricas de desempenho de plataformas digitais.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão de conteúdo (CMS).
  • Conhecimento com Sharepoint, Intranet.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de UX/UI design.
  • Inglês avançado.

Com quase três décadas de experiência, temos um histórico comprovado de cocriação de soluções inovadoras e personalizadas, ajudando nossos clientes a navegar com sucesso na era digital.
Nossa missão é conectar tecnologia e pessoas, promovendo a transformação digital em diversas áreas, com um foco especial em mídia e entretenimento. Trabalhamos para proporcionar soluções estratégicas e inovadoras, alinhando visão e ação para garantir mudanças eficazes e sustentáveis.
Na AD Digital, nosso portfólio abrange uma ampla gama de serviços e tecnologias, transformando a maneira como o conteúdo é criado, gerenciado e distribuído. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está moldando o futuro da indústria de mídia e entretenimento.
Descrição
O Analista de Soluções de Mídias Pleno será responsável por implementar e gerenciar soluções tecnológicas voltadas para a indústria de Mídia e Entretenimento, garantindo eficiência na distribuição de conteúdo multiplataforma. Essa função exige expertise em infraestrutura de TI para mídia, domínio de arquiteturas de software aplicadas ao setor e capacidade de liderança técnica em projetos complexos. O profissional atuará como elo entre as áreas técnicas, operacionais e comerciais, assegurando a qualidade e a inovação nas entregas.
Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias tecnológicas alinhadas aos objetivos do cliente e às tendências do mercado de mídia.
  • Gerenciar projetos de infraestrutura de redes, armazenamento, virtualização e bancos de dados, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance.
  • Avaliar e recomendar soluções de terceiros, conduzindo provas de conceito (POCs) e integrações sistêmicas.
  • Identificar riscos técnicos e propor planos de mitigação para garantir a continuidade das operações.
  • Atuar como consultor técnico para clientes internos e externos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções viáveis.
  • Garantir a aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura de software e padrões do setor.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores durante implantações e comissionamentos.
  • Prestar suporte especializado (sustentação) para incidentes críticos, incluindo plantões eventualmente.
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto, operações e atendimento para otimizar fluxos e qualidade dos serviços.
Requisitos

  • Familiaridade com padrões de codecs de vídeo e fluxos de trabalho em produção audiovisual.
  • Habilidade para avaliar tecnologias do mercado e propor melhorias baseadas em viabilidade técnica.

description:
Analista de Engenharia Pleno (Automação)

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022, a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de padrões técnicos para automação e sensoriamento aplicáveis em todo o grupo Aegea, garantindo consistência e eficiência.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e revisão de lógicas de controle para CLPs Siemens e Schneider, garantindo a conformidade com os padrões.
  • Realizar auditorias técnicas e avaliações de projetos para garantir que os padrões de automação e instrumentação sejam mantidos.
  • Auxiliar na configuração e programação de CLPs Siemens e Schneider para alinhar projetos ao modelo padronizado do grupo e ajustar os sistemas a condições específicas de cada unidade.
  • Prestar suporte técnico em campo para as unidades operacionais, garantindo o funcionamento adequado dos sistemas de automação.
  • Realizar treinamentos e workshops para alinhar o conhecimento técnico à padronização.
  • Documentar intervenções em campo, mantendo registros detalhados para suporte à manutenção e auditorias.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Engenharia Elétrica, Controle e Automação, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com CLPs Siemens/Schneider, redes industriais e instrumentação/automação.
  • Conhecimento em leitura e revisão de projetos, diagramas elétricos e normas técnicas.
  • Capacidade de identificar desvios, propor melhorias e registrar lições aprendidas.
  • Interesse em desenvolver competências técnicas em automação, IoT e análise de dados.
  • Disposição para atuar em equipe, dialogar com operação, manutenção e engenharia.

Why Join Us?

Our mission is simple: to create meaningful connections for every person everywhere. Passion drives us, and we believe in love. We are relentless in our pursuit to build and integrate technology that will help connect people.

Currently, the group's brands worldwide include:

  • Par Perfeito - a pioneering brand in Brazil and the largest in online serious relationships.
  • Hinge - an inclusive dating app for real people looking to meet others and pursue real-life relationships.
  • POF - a dating website for people seeking casual or serious relationships.
  • Match.com - the world's largest dating site.
  • Tinder - the leading global app to meet new people.

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Match, Hinge, PlentyOfFish, The League, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.

The Match Growth & Revenue team is looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join their newly formed Data Science pod. This new position is an exciting opportunity to apply insights and identify wins across our portfolio of brands (including Match, OKCupid, and PlentyOfFish). The role will drive tangible business impact through the analysis of test results and ecosystem trends, collaboration with our Product and Development groups, and quantitative research on how our users find love.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for doing our best work so we work together IRL in our Dallas office 2 days/week.

How You'll Make An Impact:

  • Liaise with individual brands to understand their business models, track ecosystem trends, and identify opportunities across the portfolio
  • Conduct quantitative research to better understand user behavior and inform future initiatives
  • Collaborate with other teams, including Product and Development, to shepherd projects from ideation to delivery
  • Propose and design tests for discounting, merchandising, and pricing, with a focus on cross-brand applicability
  • Monitor AB tests, including identifying opportunities for segmentation and iteration, and modelling the long-term ecosystem and revenue impacts.
  • Improve consistency and efficiency of internal querying, reporting, and dashboarding processes

We Could Be A Match If:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a role related to business analytics or product analytics
  • You are proficient in SQL (MSSQL and/or Redshift preferred)
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office and/or Google Drive apps, especially Excel/Sheets
  • You are proficient in statistical software such as R or Python
  • You have a sound understanding of statistics and modelling techniques
  • You have the ability to work collaboratively on a diverse team, featuring colleagues of different backgrounds, specialties, and levels of technical knowledge
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent knowledge) or higher in business, economics, mathematics, quantitative social sciences, statistics, or related field

Why work with us?

Our mission is simple - to help people find love and happiness! We also take great care of our employees.

Here at Match Group LatAm, you'll have:

  • Annual Check-up: To take care of our team's well-being, we offer an annual medical check-up for all employees aged 40+, promoting health and well-being through preventive medicine;
  • "Baby Bonding Leave" - extended paternity leave. Here at #Match, we believe that caring for the next generation is a gender-neutral investment. As soon as an employee's baby is born, the father takes 100% paid leave for 12 weeks.

title: HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR
description:
HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic people who are passionate about making each day better for all employees — and you will play a crucial role in this journey! Our People eXperience & Technology (PXT - Human Resources) professionals care deeply about the employee experience and support employees and leaders in focusing on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.


Key job responsibilities

In this position, you will be responsible for the entire PXT (People eXperience and Technology - Human Resources) agenda in an Amazon logistics warehouse located in São João de Meriti - RJ. The generalist role in HR will involve managing the mobilization/demobilization of workforce in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to manager levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, operational vacancy fill rates), indirect coordination of chartered transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.


A day in the life
As an HRBP of a "Fulfillment Center - FC", no two days are alike, but a typical day will likely include the following responsibilities:

  1. Work with a team of HR Assistants to create the best experience for employees.
  2. Lead the reporting and analysis of Human Resources metrics and goals ("attendance", "attrition", "fill-rate", delving into root cause analyses and improvement plans).
  3. Participate in "Daily Dive Deep – DDD" meetings along with the Operations team and other support areas.
  4. Co-lead workforce planning meetings, execution of mobilization and demobilization of personnel contingent.
  5. Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes, as well as the work environment and people's needs, on the "shop-floor".
  6. Monitor the environment from a labor and employee relations perspective, identifying trends and risks.
  7. Participate in Brazil PXT Operations team meetings, reporting metrics and indicators of your operation.
  8. Lead PXT and multidisciplinary projects that go beyond your work unit.
  9. Promote and model an inclusive environment for all employees through specific programs, local initiatives, and affinity groups.
  10. Serve as the first point of escalation for employee concerns.
  11. Support employee inquiries and situations with discretion and experience, along with routine standard work on employee onboarding, performance management, engagement processes, and benefits services.
  12. Train, develop, and support leadership through decision-making.
  13. Collaborate with various levels of the organization, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  14. Influence and guide partners to prioritize employee experience and customer obsession.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Completed Bachelors Degree
Experience in generalist Human Resources subsystems.
Experience in supporting massive and operational customer groups (factories, warehouses, call centers, etc).
Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (reads and writes easily and fluently, understands ~85% when listening and can provide quick and objective answers).
Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel at an intermediate level (VLOOKUP and pivot tables); BI tools will be a differential.
Must be willing to work 100% on-site at the FC in São João de Meriti-RJ, with flexibility in hours and days, especially during peak periods or promotions (Prime Day, Black Friday).


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience in HR for factory/manufacturing, transportation company, distribution center, or logistics.
Masters Degree

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Career Area:

Human Resources

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you'rejoining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don'tjust talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

We are Hiring! Join a team where your insights shape the future of our people and culture.

Are you passionate about creating a thriving workplace where people feel valued, supported, and empowered? We’re looking for anHR Business Partnerwho’s ready to make a real impact by driving employee engagement, supporting leadership, and enhancing organizational effectiveness.

What You will Do

As a strategic partner to our leadership team, you will:

  • Provide expert guidance on employee relations, performance management, and organizational development.

  • Collaborate with senior leaders to shape talent strategies and improve employee experience.

  • Lead compensation and performance evaluation programs, ensuring fairness and alignment with business goals.

  • Support transitions with empathy—handling outplacement counseling and exit interviews.

  • Conduct organizational assessments and recommend impactful solutions.

What You Bring

  • A degree in HR, Business, or related field—or equivalent experience.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to align HR strategies with company goals.

  • Experience navigating employee relations with professionalism and care.

  • A collaborative mindset and excellent interpersonal skills.

  • Confidence in data gathering, reporting, and making informed decisions.

  • English proficiency is preferred; Spanish is a strong plus.

Skills That Set You Apart

  • Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

  • Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

  • Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner.

  • Knowledge of Organization: Knowledge of the organization's vision, structure, culture, philosophy, operating principles, values, and code of ethics; ability to understand the value of aligning capabilities with business goals to support optimal performance.

  • Data Gathering and Reporting: Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company.

  • Employee Relations: Knowledge of the rights and obligations in the employee relations; ability to adhere to legal requirements when handling employee negotiations.

Nerdy's comprehensive learning destination provides learning experiences across 3,000+ subjects and multiple formats—including one-on-one instruction, small group classes, large format group classes, on-demand study support, and adaptive self-study. Nerdy's flagship business, Varsity Tutors, is one of the nation's largest platforms for live online tutoring and classes. description:

Wärtsilä Parts and Field Service is now looking for an enthusiastic Team Leader Resources, In-Situ to join our skilled team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe, and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that approximately 90% of world trade is carried by sea?
We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services- together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

What will you be doing?

As a Team Leader In-Situ Resources, you will be responsible for leading and developing a In-Situ Resources Team consisting of In-Situ Machining Engineers and Technicians in Brazil, in accordance with the strategy, action plan and business needs.

Effective July 2025, Wärtsilä Brazil will implement a new hybrid work model. Most employees who live within 65 kilometres of an office will work 6 days per month in office. This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. We will be happy to provide more information during your interview process.

This position reports to the In-Situ Resources Manager .

Candidates are expected to display a high level of critical thinking and reasoning skills, identify as high performers, as well as being self-motivating.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate the In-Situ demand during the year and define appropriate actions (including recruiting).
  • Development of your team competencies as required to address current and future needs.
  • Manage personnel responsibilities including selection, training, performance appraisal, discipline, and safety in the field. Foster team development and a continuous learning environment. Monitor team performance and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Ensure that the team is utilized effectively, having the right people in the right place at the right time.
  • Foster strategic relationships with institutes of leaning to attract and develop talent.
  • Manage and maintain internal and external relationships, focused on achieving company targets.
  • Facilitate good collaboration with key stakeholders throughout the delivery chain (Sales, Lifecycle Support, Agreements, Technical Service).
  • Contribute to the annual budget preparation and service forecast evaluations.
  • Set the individual performance and development targets of your team.
  • Monitor and control the monthly process KPIs in Resources, seeking to provide information to those responsible for identifying potential failures and improvements through action plans.
  • To comply with the company's Quality, Health & Safety and Equal Opportunities policies.
  • In addition to the above duties and responsibilities, the post holder must be prepared to undertake such additional duties within their capabilities which may result from changing circumstances, but which may not, of necessity, change the general character or level of responsibility of the post.

Main Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or technical university or equivalent work experience in a technical service-minded organization is desired
  • Job-related experience with a technical degree and/or bachelor’s degree, and some project management experience or training is required
  • Service management skills and/or experience with coordinating service teams is desirable
  • Experience with reciprocating engines and ancillary equipment in a Mechanical/Maritime environment is required
  • Thorough understanding of the Field Service process
  • English language proficiency (Spanish considered as plus)
  • Be proficient with process tools such as SalesForce (CRM), Qlikview and FS Mobility

As an ideal candidate, we expect you to have:

  • High integrity
  • Passionate about people
  • Strong focus on quality and safety
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in languages needed to support the team
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to lead persons of different cultural backgrounds
  • Good understand of profit and loss and cost to serve

Successful applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.

Why you & us?

Wartsila is committed to Employment Equity, supports diversity in the workplace, and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including women, members of visible minorities, Indigenous persons, and persons with disabilities.

If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to support your request.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.

Contact & next steps:

Does this sound like the job for you? If yes, wehope to hear from you before the applicationdeadline by submitting your application in our Career portal. Our recruiting tool recognizes the time zone where the job ad has been published and closes the application period according to the same time zone. We aim to keep you informed along the way.

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - EXCLUSIVO PARA PESSOA COM DEFICIÊNCIA
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nº 57.925 de 04/03/1966, nº 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e nº 8.911 de 30/07/1970.

Ela atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, alinhada às suas políticas de saúde e educação, sendo também uma organização social habilitada em diversos estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A missão principal da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, focada no tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, com forte vínculo com a comunidade local, reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação, incluindo projetos em desenvolvimento na assistência social e na educação. Essas atividades consolidam a sua posição como uma grande instituição filantrópica, buscando sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados e experientes.

Dispomos de um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para que possamos direcionar você às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho: a definir;
  • Local de trabalho: zonas Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculos de parentesco ou afinidade, ou que atuem em modalidades contratuais distintas, devem consultar as normas de RH vigentes com o setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM também oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência, divulgando periodicamente anúncios em jornais principais de São Paulo e demais municípios onde atua.

Missão: Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com alta qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão: Ser referência na gestão de serviços de saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis de assistência e garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: LNG Research and Financial Analyst
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

09

The Team :

Commodity Insights Analytics is looking for an analyst to support S&P Global’s LNG subscription service through a focus on financial and economic analysis of liquefaction projects around the world, as well as a targeted market analysis of those within North America. This role will involve research and modelling of project-level cash flow drivers, including capital expenditures, local tax obligations, and bilateral contract pricing terms. It will also include writing forward-looking market commentary on the North American LNG industry. Leveraging your strong research and modelling skills, as well as your clear understanding of generally accepted financial analysis concepts, this role will be central to building upon our market-leading LNG service.


Responsibilities and Impact:

Commodity Insights is a global team responsible for analyzing, interpreting, and forecasting global LNG markets and prices. This exciting role will be pivotal in maintaining a robust financial analysis function and creating key market commentaries for clients to understand the North American market. You will be contributing to the deep expertise upon which a broad base of leading companies has come to rely. Our analysis serves a wide range of customers across the energy industry. This is a role with significant potential for development. You will be a key member of the Commodity Insights LNG team, assisting in the synthesis of an integrated, cross-commodity, global analysis offering. In addition, there will be opportunities to participate in customer-facing activities.

  • Research and integrate our current views on key valuation drivers associated with LNG liquefaction projects into team models
  • Research, analyze, and communicate all factors that contribute to the current and expected future value of LNG in North American markets, and their interaction with global energy markets
  • Deliver succinct, high-quality, and accurate charts, presentations, and reports that help core readership make better-informed trading, risk management, and investment decisions
  • Spot and identify emerging trends early and, where possible, anticipate market movements by developing a solid understanding of natural gas/LNG trading, modeling, and forecasting
  • Engage with clients, market experts, and prospects (limited travel will be required)
  • Build internal relationships that will help generate ideas for the integration of cross-commodity analysis to offer greater value to customers

What We’re Looking For:

  • Knowledge of North American natural gas and/or LNG markets. Experience in other markets such as power, coal, and oil is a plus
  • Strong Excel skills are fundamental to success in this role
  • Verbal and written fluency in English is essential, knowledge of Spanish seen favorably; ability to clearly communicate in English to a broad group of people is foundational
  • Ability to recognize trends and develop logical conclusions
  • Demonstrable understanding of project-level valuation and analysis concepts and modelling. Clear experience with and fluency in concepts such as cash flow, NPV, IRR, EBITDA, leverage, net operating loss carryforwards, etc. are fundamental to this role.
  • Clear and concise writing style, and strong communication and presentation skills to provide insightful analysis in compelling and straightforward content
  • Motivation to seek out new assignments and act on opportunities
  • Comfortable with high levels of individual responsibility and accountability
  • Demonstrates personal integrity and an openness to continually learn and develop

**Please include a cover letter**

At S&P Global Commodity Insights, our complete view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make decisions with conviction and create long-term, sustainable value.

We’re a trusted connector that brings together thought leaders, market participants, governments, and regulators to co-create solutions that lead to progress. Vital to navigating Energy Transition, S&P Global Commodity Insights’ coverage includes oil and gas, power, chemicals, metals, agriculture and shipping.

S&P Global Commodity Insights is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

Progress is not a self-starter. It requires a catalyst to be set in motion. Information, imagination, people, technology–the right combination can unlock possibility and change the world.

We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. We’re constantly seeking new solutions that have progress in mind. Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Job Title: System Completion Coordinator

About us:

Saipem is a global leader in engineering services for the design, construction and operation of complex infrastructures and plants in the energy sector, both offshore and onshore.

With our five business lines - Asset Based Services, Energy Carriers, Offshore Wind, Sustainable Infrastructures, Robotics & Industrialized Solutions - we are One Company present in around 60 countries with over 30,000 employees of more than 130 nationalities, providing the world the innovative excellence of our people and our partners for over 65 years.

Mission

Coordinate the achievement of the plant process and utilities systems completion as defined in the project plans and schedules, in order to hand-over the systems to commissioning Team, coordinating all construction disciplines according to the established time frame and priorities and interfacing with Heads of Departments, Subcontractors, Suppliers and Clients.

Tasks

Promote safe work practices and environmental protection, ensuring that safety standards are respected
Ensure the fulfillment of the project quality and contractual requirements
Set up proper tools to control the progressive completion of construction and pre-commissioning activities
Guide and monitor the field activities in an orderly manner according to commissioning priorities
Plan walkthroughs with Client and disciplines involved, in accordance with systems completion priorities, in order to determine the required actions to be completed to achieve the mechanical completion
Steer coordination meetings in a perspective of an overall optimization, in terms of system completion or alternative solutions to mitigate the inconveniences that might occur
Ensure the gathering and management of completion punch lists, including both yes and no items.
Ensure the preparation of the certificates dossiers required to achieve the mechanical completion, in accordance with contractual provisions

title: Analista Sr de Gestão de Contas, MVR
description:
Job ID: 2939683 | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

Essa é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras.
A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. No Brasil , estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos príncipios de liderança, com objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”. Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “ Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI. Além disso, atuam como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o Day 1. Lembre-se “ it´s always Day 1”. Os grupos estão organizados nas seguintes frentes: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.
Estamos em busca de uma pesssoa para atuar como Analista Sênior de Gestão de Contas, desempenhando um papel crucial em nosso time de Massive Vendor Recruitment (MVR), sendo responsável por criar parcerias sólidas e acelerar o crescimento de fornecedores de alto potencial em nosso negócio.
O time de MVR é formado por diversos programas que atuam em algumas frentes como Selection, Qualidade de Catálogo, Eficiencia Operacional, Disponibilidade e Rentabilidade, trabalhando em cooperação com os times das Famílias de Produtos e centrais para atingirmos nossos objetivos.
Desafios da Função:
Gestão de Fornecedores: Desenvolver planos personalizados de aceleração e crescimento para cada fornecedor.
Negociações e Planejamento: Liderar negociações de compras a médio/longo prazo, criar planos completos de investimento do fornecedor (orçamentos de vendas, apresentação de resultados e marketing para cada negócio).
Estratégias e Análises: Ser responsável por estabelecer estratégias inovadoras, análise de dados dos negócios e planos de impulsionamento do desempenho dos fornecedores.
Promoções e Ofertas: Elaborar ofertas e promoções, identificando oportunidades de crescimento para nossos parceiros e para a Amazon.com.br.
Key job responsibilities
- Acelerar a aquisição de selection relevante e habilitar o crescimento enquanto negócio de cada fornecedor;
- Gerenciar fornecedores de uma Família de Produtos específica, sendo responsável pelo P&L do negócio;
- Responsável pelos principais resultados operacionais e financeiros do fornecedor, desenvolvendo planos que impulsionem receita e margem de melhoria de performance;
- Atuar como hunter e/ou farmer, desenvolvendo e graduando os fornecedores em nossos programas internos.
- Gestão massiva de métricas de performance, eliminando obstáculos operacionais e identificando oportunidades de aceleração de demanda;
- Realizar o onboarding de novos fabricantes, contribuindo com o target de nova selection da Amazon e com melhor custo, visando aumentar a conversão catálogo.

- Ensino superior concluído;
- Experiência em gestão de contas, gerenciamento de produtos ou programas;
- Atuação com gerenciamento de projetos;
- Analisar e acompanhar os principais KPIs e contribuir com Insights;
- Experiência em negociações de fornecedores, preços e promoções, gerenciamento de estoque e desenvolvimento de produtos;
- Excel intermediário.

- Proficiência avançada em Excel;
- Conhecimento de SQL;
- Inglês intermediário / avançado.

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
Video Editor for YouTube

When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: I actually read the instructions

If you can't edit like this, this job is not for you. You must at least be able to edit at this level.

This is another example. If you can edit like this, you are very likely to get the job.

Who We're Looking For

You're a visual storyteller. You understand how to weave together raw footage, graphics, and sound to create compelling video content, with a particular focus on transforming property tours, market updates, and agent expertise into engaging real estate content that drives leads and builds authority. You obsess over the smallest details - the right cut, the perfect transition, the ideal color grade - without losing sight of the overall narrative. You're capable of taking a creative brief and bringing it to life through video, consistently delivering high-quality content within rapid turnaround times.

You have a discerning eye and ear for video and sound design. You appreciate the subtleties of color grading and understand how to use sound design to enhance the visual experience. Your creative expertise isn't limited to "Layer 1" or "Audio Track 2" - you deliver clean, organized project files that are easy for others to work with.

You are a YouTube specialist. You're familiar with the unique requirements of editing for YouTube, from creating engaging openings that hook viewers, to incorporating calls to action, to optimizing for viewer retention. You're always up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices on the platform, particularly in real estate content.

You are a great communicator and can workalongside strategy and media teams, you collaborate effectively within established workflows. You report to and learn from an experienced YouTube Manager while maintaining direct communication with multiple real estate clients. You appreciate the insights and feedback that come from collaboration and are not afraid to ask questions or offer your own ideas. You take pride in your work, are reliable, and strive to deliver your best on every project.

What You'll Do

    • Take raw footage from real estate clients and edit and animate video content, ensuring it aligns with their scripts, goals and brand
    • Deliver high-quality video content within 72 hour turnaround times
    • Maintain consistent output of 2-3+ videos per week per client while meeting quality standards
    • Utilize Adobe Premiere and After Effects to create engaging, high-quality YouTube videos (bonus if you know Davinci)
    • Apply your expertise in color grading, audio mixing and sound design to enhance the viewing experience
    • Work closely with our team of producers, script writers, and designers to bring creative concepts to life
    • Deliver well-organized project files and facilitate the handoff to other team members or clients as needed

What You'll Bring

    • 2-3+ years experience in video editing and animation, preferably within a YouTube-focused context
    • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere and After Effects
    • Strong skills in color grading, audio mixing and sound design
    • Experience working as part of a creative team and collaborating on video projects
    • Strong attention to detail, with a dedication to quality and consistency
    • Data-driven mindset with focus on viewer retention metrics and content performance
    • Ability to balance quick turnaround times with consistent quality standards
    • Experience with or strong interest in real estate content creation
    • Deep understanding of YouTube platform and current trends in digital video content
    • Collaborative spirit and a commitment to meeting deadlines

What You'll Get

    • You'll be part of a structured production system with clear processes and support
    • You'll work with a dedicated and established team of 30+ creative professionals who are passionate about creating great YouTube content
    • You'll contribute directly to our established 35+ clients' business growth, helping them generate over $250M/YR last yearin real estate sales through YouTube content
    • You'll receive competitive salary, benefits, and flexible time-off
    • You'll get to work remotely, from wherever you want! (As long as it has reliable WiFi and a comfortable place for you to work)
    • You'll be challenged with a diverse array of real estate projects and clients, providing a dynamic and rewarding work environment
    • You'll get access to grow within your video career or potentially venture into more of the creative management/leadership side

Who we are

A Impact Media is a specialized creative & growth marketing agency helping real estate professionals build their own media brands instead of buying expensive leads. We transform top-producing agents and teams (doing $10M to $1B in annual volume) into local market authorities through done-for-you YouTube content, email marketing, and brand development.

Our dedicated team of 30+ experts has generated over 10M+ YouTube views and helped our clients achieve more than $250M in sales last year aloen for clients. We're not just a service provider we're a growth partner obsessed with turning real estate professionals into media companies that naturally attract the right clients and team members.

With a track record of producing over 1,200 videos, 3,600+ thumbnails, and hundreds of newsletters for industry leaders, we combine creative excellence with proven systems to deliver consistent results. Our core values of proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence drive everything we do.

Make sure you're comfortable with:

  • Remote working. This is completely remote (work from home) position.
  • A multi-step hiring process
  • Open opportunities to work as much or as little as you want
  • All job offers start with a 30 to 60-day paid trial to make sure that were the right fit for each other.
  • Pay ranges from $1,400 to $2,000 depending on volume output, skill & experience and bonuses

To apply:

If you're interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Editor.pdf)
  • Details of your video editing experience
  • Send a link to your completed personality quiz:
  • Your answer to this question: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible" - Khalil Gibran

Submissions should go to:

I will be looking for people who can format their submission in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in client management you want to help make it as easy on the client as possible! Im happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

  • Realizar análise, conferência, armazenagem e movimentação de material do estoque.
  • Receber, conferir e organizar os materiais e medicamentos entregues pelos fornecedores, assegurando a conformidade dos itens e seu armazenamento adequado no setor.
  • Cumprir efetivamente com o preenchimento do checklist (possíveis divergências nas notas fiscais e na ordem de compra), garantindo a veracidade das informações lançadas no sistema.

title: TÉCNICO DE MEC NICA / Mechanical Technician
description:
TÉCNICO DE MECÂNICA / Mechanical Technician

Responsável por executar a manutenção mecânica de todos os equipamentos e sistemas do Topside, apoiando também a manutenção na praça de máquinas, sala de bombas e sistemas marítimos. O objetivo é manter altos padrões de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva de forma eficiente, seguindo cronogramas, procedimentos e a filosofia de manutenção da MODEC, bem como regulações e padrões nacionais e internacionais. Assim, contribuímos para que todos os equipamentos e sistemas estejam operacionais e preservados na unidade designada.

Buscamos profissional para a posição de Técnico de Mecânica para atuar em oportunidade Offshore.

As principais funções incluem:

  • Executar atividades de manutenção em máquinas, equipamentos de operação, reparação e emergência, garantindo a segurança e eficiência operacional;
  • Alinhar e acoplar máquinas com acionadores, auxiliar na manutenção de motores, compressores, bombas, geradores e outros equipamentos;
  • Realizar soldagem, corte, lixamento, uso de maçarico a gás, máquina de torno e ferramentas pneumáticas, requisito mandatório;
  • Desmontar, limpar, remontar peças, reparar ou substituir componentes danificados ou desgastados;
  • Reparar máquinas e equipamentos após falhas;
  • Seguir as instruções do Supervisor de Manutenção ou Superintendente, mantendo-os informados sobre o progresso, estoque de peças, materiais utilizados e reparos;
  • Manter as áreas de trabalho limpas e organizadas;
  • Implementar o sistema de Permissão de Trabalho (PTW), incluindo isolamento, cancelamento e emissão de certificados, conforme procedimentos da MODEC;
  • Registrar ordens de trabalho no CMMS, atualizar informações de peças e consumíveis, e comunicar o status ao Supervisor de Manutenção ou Superintendente.

Requisitos:

  • Formação Técnica em Mecânica;
  • Experiência com Refrigeração (compressores);
  • Inglês avançado.

Fazer parte da MODEC significa protagonizar uma carreira cheia de desafios, atuando com sistemas de produção em águas profundas. Sua carreira começa no Brasil, mas seu talento pode levá-lo ao mundo.

Se deseja estar entre os melhores do mercado, esta é sua oportunidade!

Como empresa multicultural que valoriza a diversidade, incentivamos candidaturas de PCDs.

Sobre a empresa - About us

Se você é dinâmico, comprometido, inovador e deseja atuar em uma multinacional referência na indústria de óleo e gás, venha conosco nesta jornada.

SOMOS a MODEC, maior operadora independente de plataformas FPSO no mundo, investindo em profissionais que buscam desafios e crescimento em uma empresa sólida, ética e multicultural.

Trabalhar na MODEC é estar em um ambiente global. Sua carreira pode começar no Brasil, mas seu talento pode levá-lo para o mundo. Com mais de 50 anos de experiência na indústria de óleo e gás, atuamos em cinco continentes e estamos há 20 anos no Brasil, apoiando o setor de óleo e gás.

A empresa valoriza cada pessoa, reconhecendo seu papel e importância, refletido nos benefícios oferecidos, incluindo:

description:
Quem somos?
  • Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.
O que buscamos?
  • Estamos buscando um profissional que irá atuar em nosso hospital, garantindo a segurança, o controle de acesso e o atendimento aos pacientes, colaboradores e visitantes. O profissional será responsável por zelar pela tranquilidade do ambiente hospitalar, seguindo os protocolos de segurança e oferecendo um atendimento humanizado.
Dia a Dia
  • Controlar o acesso de pessoas, veículos e fornecedores nas dependências do hospital, seguindo normas e procedimentos internos;
  • Realizar o atendimento e orientação de pacientes, familiares e visitantes, prestando informações sobre localização de setores e horários de visita;
  • Monitorar o fluxo de pessoas nas entradas e saídas, mantendo a ordem e segurança no ambiente;
  • Acionar a equipe de segurança e/ou assistência médica em situações de emergência ou ocorrências no local;
  • Elaborar relatórios diários de controle de acesso e registrar ocorrências relevantes.
Local de trabalho: Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro
Horário: Plantonista 12x36 (Diurno 07:00 as 19:00)
Requisitos
O que precisamos que você tenha:
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência prévia como porteiro, preferencialmente em ambiente hospitalar ou em áreas de grande fluxo de pessoas;
  • Postura ética e profissional, com foco no atendimento humanizado.
O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana e feriados, quando necessário.
  • Boa comunicação, empatia e capacidade de lidar com o público em situações sensíveis;
Benefícios
Benefícios
  • Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
  • Saúde: Plano de saúde Amil, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico Odontoprev e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
  • Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.
  • Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.
  • Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.
